through_line: Made known and protected in pieces: Beglar's report (1871–72) carrying the Aurangzeb legend, corrected from the inscriptions in Cunningham's (1874–77); the bedi and the eight-shrine plan as fixtures; the records in the Survey's files; Kramrisch's 1946 model resting on the reports; Gwalior State's department under Garde finding the second slab and removing it to Gwalior, restoring (1923–29) and resetting the serpent slab; a new state's list, two central and four state monuments, the palace protected by no one; spending reported at second hand; one remembered clearance; INTACH's survey of the whole town (2020–21), a list without legal force; the palace notice and the revenue order of 15 January 2021 (U7); a stolen Umā-Maheśvara and defaced sculpture; quarries, blasts, herds and a cracking repair on the hill, leading to the people of Chapter 12.
